pilot3_change.reason: The paper's own code caches a preprocessed file inside its data directory (data/california_housing/). A writable per-run copy of the data lets it write there without touching the host cache.

multi_seed.seed_source: bin/ft_transformer.py reads its configuration with lib.load_config() and calls zero.set_randomness(args['seed']); the repository holds output/california_housing/ft_transformer/default/0.toml to 14.toml, which differ from each other only in their first line, `seed = N` (0.toml, the file of the existing runs, and 2.toml compared line by line).
multi_seed.note: not a protocol run (docs/MULTI_SEED.md): one of several runs of the same paper that differ only in the paper's own seed parameter

cpus_override.note: not a protocol run: the CPU limit replaces the protocol's (#331)

timeout_override.note: not a protocol run: the time limit of the run phase replaces the protocol's (#396)
